title: Illustrated card assembles in layers, holds, fades
summary: A single portrait card scales in on a blush background, its title rises out of a mask and the illustrated scene builds layer by layer from the bottom; copy fades in, the scene settles, holds 2 s and fades out to loop.
use_when: Showing one app card, desktop panel or onboarding screen as a calm hero moment
A square loop for a feed or a landing page tile
A product whose screen carries illustration that can be split into depth layers
Silent autoplay where one name and one short line are enough

look.type_style: medium grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking; title ~5.5 % H in pale pink on the card, tracked uppercase eyebrow ~1.3 % H, two-line centred description ~1.4 % H, small outline play-icon button label

sfx.event: title rises out of its mask

structure.shot: empty blush frame, then a portrait card with a purple-to-pink sky gradient; title and back-to-front scenery layers build inside it
structure.camera: locked off; the card itself scales 0.89 -> 1.00 about the frame centre (f8 -> f23)
structure.motion: card enters f0-f8 at scale 0.89, springs.ui to 1.00 by f23 (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s); title mask-rise f15-f23 (±0.25 s); far treeline rises from the card's bottom edge by f15, cliffs, near trees and river by f23, foreground bushes by f30, each layer easings.outExpo ~8 fr, stagger ~7 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: same card: eyebrow, two-line description and a small play button appear; flowers and a pale sun complete the scene
structure.camera: locked off; inner artwork pull-out about 1.7 %/s while it settles (motion.json second 1)
structure.motion: eyebrow, description and button fade in together f26-f38, easings.outQuint (±0.25 s); flower dots appear by f45; sun disc rises behind the valley f45-f60, easings.outExpo (±0.25 s); all layers settle by f60

structure.shot: finished card holds: name, line, button over the full illustrated scene, soft pink drop shadow
structure.motion: full hold 60 fr, no element moves (motion.json diff 0.00 for seconds 2 and 3)

structure.shot: the whole card and its shadow fade out to the empty blush background, matching frame 0 for a loop
structure.motion: card opacity 1 -> ~0.7 (f128) -> ~0.45 (f135) -> ~0.08 (f143) -> 0 by f150, no scale or position change; curve close to easings.linear (±0.25 s)

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the frame, card gradient from two brand colours, pale fg for type, display font
params.content.eyebrow: short uppercase label above the name ('' = none)
params.content.name: product or screen name, one or two words
params.content.line: description, up to 2 lines, about 12 words
params.content.button: button label next to a play or arrow icon, 1 word
params.content.layers: 3-6 transparent PNG/SVG scenery layers, back to front, plus an optional sun/orb layer
params.aspect: 1:1 default; card stays 42 % W x 62 % H of the square, recomposes for 4:5 and 9:16
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Single shot, no cuts, silent; loops because the first and last frames are the empty background. Card 42 % W x 62 % H, corner radius ~3 % W, large soft pink shadow. Card scale-in starts at 0.89, not 0. Scenery builds back to front, roughly one layer per 0.25 s cell; sun is the last element (f45-f60). Inner art drifts down in scale ~1.7 %/s during second 1. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): layer-rise (illustration layers rise from the card's bottom edge in depth order), card-scale-in (whole card scales from ~0.9 with no fade), fade-loop (whole frame fades back to the empty first frame).
